salarySource.title: IIM Kashipur Final Placement Report 2023-25 (Audited, Infomerics Analytics & Research)
salarySource.quote: 2. SALARY DATA — 'Median 1446950' (CTC; Data 433); highlights page: 'Median INR 14.46 LPA'. Transcribed from page images (tables are images, not extractable text). NOTE: report covers MBA and MBA (Analytics) together. NIRF 2025 cross-check: 1503084 for graduates of 2023-24.

cutoffs.notes: Stage: shortlisting (JAP 2026 registration eligibility, pre-PI). CAT 2025, JAP 2026 (coordinated by IIM Raipur). Academic minimums from same table: GEN/EWS/NC-OBC Class X 60, XII 60, Graduation 50; SC/ST X 55, XII 55, Grad 45; PwD 45/45/45. Positive scaled score required in all sections. 'actual ... cut-offs may be much higher'. CONFLICT: IIM Kashipur's own MBA 2026-28 Admission Policy PDF (https://www.iimkashipur.ac.in/admin/pdf/173372323875.pdf) and MBA admission page still show the CAT-2024 table (General QA/DILR/VRC 75/75/75, total 95; EWS 55/55/55, 81; NC-OBC 52/52/52, 81; SC 45/45/45, 66; ST 30/25/25, 42; PwD 30/25/25, 42) with note '* The cut-offs for the 2026-28 batch will be updated soon in accordance with JAP 2026 guidelines.' The JAP 2026 table is used here as the 2026-28 minimum.
